description:
Get available chemical probes for a target.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table target_chemical_probes — one record = one chemical probe of one target from one origin.
Key: id, chemicalProbes[].id, chemicalProbes[].origin.
Arguments: target_id accepts ensembl gene or hgnc symbol (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: one row = one item (one chemical probe of one target from one origin); `_vbt.total` counts items.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. Probes listed by Probes & Drugs as integrated in OT 25.09; covered for genes whose list is present (empty = none listed).

target_id.description: Accepts ensembl_gene, hgnc_symbol; resolved to one ensembl_gene (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
